name: Y's Sports Bar & Grill
description: Kama'aina Karaoke is a cozy and inviting karaoke venue that stands out for its extensive selection of six karaoke live-streaming systems and spacious layout, making it easy to sing and enjoy with friends. The venue offers a relaxed, local atmosphere with friendly staff and a good sound system, perfect for both casual singing and hosting big dart tournaments. It’s a great spot to feel at home while enjoying karaoke, food, and drinks in a welcoming environment.
